report: We're 2-7, so we need wins now. Rachaad White already played Thursday and the team has 6.2 points in so far. Stevenson is Questionable. If he is ruled out, Woody Marks takes the flex spot. The lineup is otherwise set, so there are no start/sit changes. Jameson Williams (16.03 over his last 3) and Tee Higgins (28.17 over his last 3) are both trending up. The most important trade to send is the one to daddyisback8 for Ashton Jeanty, who adds about 3 points a week over our flex. I'm also sending Tuten, Cousins, Kelce and Braelon Allen. This league is stingy, so each offer is built as a clear win for the other owner.

team_breakdown.note: Stafford averages 15.87 but only 12.33 over his last 3, with a 9.12 floor. He faces ARI, which ranks 2nd in points allowed to QBs, so this is a fine matchup. The position is still below the league's best.
Javonte Williams is excellent: 17.73 average, 23 carries a game, 11 floor. Rachaad White is thin at 9.74. Stevenson is a good flex (16.43 last 3) but carries a Questionable tag.
Higgins 19.98 (28.17 last 3) and McMillan 15.56 are a good pair, and Jameson Williams adds 13.21. Depth behind them is weak: Flournoy 9.31 and McConkey 8.6 on a Questionable tag.
LaPorta averages 11.64 but has dropped to 5.5 over his last 3. He still has a good matchup against NE, who rank 26th against TEs.
Stevenson (12.63) and Jameson Williams fill the flex slots. If Stevenson sits, Marks (8.86 average, 8.28 floor) is a steady but low-ceiling fill-in.
Seth McGowan averages 3.63 and Zonovan Knight has no real role. Only Marks, Flournoy and Dell hold any real value.

plan: Upgrade RB2 from White (9.74) to Jeanty or Tuten for roughly +3 to +6 points a week.
Steady the TE slot by swapping LaPorta (last 3: 5.5) for Kelce (12.47 last 3).
Add a better QB through Cousins (19.14 average) to replace Stafford's 15.87.
